definitions.explanation: A variety of peach with pale, cream-colored flesh and a delicate, sweet flavor. The most common type of {桃|もも} sold in Japan, prized for its softness and aroma; contrasts with {黄桃|おうとう} (yellow peach).

examples.japanese: この{白桃|はくとう}はとても{甘|あま}くてジューシーだ。
examples.english: These white peaches are very sweet and juicy.

examples.japanese: {岡山県|おかやまけん}は{高品質|こうひんしつ}の{白桃|はくとう}の{産地|さんち}として{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: Okayama Prefecture is famous as a producer of high-quality white peaches.

notes:
Compound of {白|はく} (white) + {桃|とう} (peach). Considered a premium summer fruit; high-end specimens are sold individually packed as gifts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白桃|はくとう}ジュース: white peach juice
- {白桃|はくとう}ゼリー: white peach jelly
- {岡山|おかやま}の{白桃|はくとう}: Okayama white peaches (the most famous region)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {黄桃|おうとう}: yellow peach — firmer flesh, often used for canning and baking
- {桃|もも}: peach — the general term; usually {白桃|はくとう} unless otherwise specified
